title: Detention and Semester
author: E. M. Villalobos
blurb: Quentin Thornbury, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, has spent twelve years being so careful it hurts. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
